items.text: Aasi Siddique's campaign says he has decades of experience in risk management, finance, insurance, real estate, transportation, logistics, regulatory compliance, organizational management, and military service. He says he wants to establish priorities, coordinate agencies, scrutinize spending, and communicate with residents.
